verdict.rationale: New Relic's own NerdGraph API and CLIs let users query and fetch their data, and the CLI outputs JSON or YAML. OpenTelemetry instrumentation keeps collection platform-agnostic, which eases leaving. There is no documented bulk or full-account export, so exporting everything would mean scripting many queries. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all data types (logs, metrics, traces, events) in open formats, export of dashboards, alerts and configuration, documented offboarding or retention-on-exit terms, and independent corroboration that a complete export works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
